name: How Often OPERA Maps Surface Water

metadata.description: Every 110 km MGRS tile that NASA OPERA's DSWx-HLS product mapped in July 2025, colored by the number of days with at least one DSWx-HLS granule from Landsat 8/9 or Sentinel-2, from 380,000 granules listed in NASA CMR. Overlapping polar orbits make high latitudes the most often mapped; South and Southeast Asia, under the July monsoon, the least. Source: NASA OPERA (JPL) granule metadata from NASA CMR.
